title: Robot Championship
statement: The task is to output at most 3n anti-diagonals r+c=v to shoot, one per second, on an n×n board (n up to 100) so that a hidden adversarial robot moving up, right or down-left is surely hit. The key invariant is that (r+c−t) mod 3 never changes, splitting robots into three classes; a sweep v, v−2, v−4, … from the top diagonal kills one class in about n shots.
